tailoring.headline: IT Consultant eCommerce | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, and techno-functional business analysis. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with proven integration and production support experience.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: IT Consultant eCommerce Logistik (w/m/d)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by dmTECH’s focus on cutting-edge eCommerce logistics solutions that combine technology and operational excellence. With over five years of delivering SAP Commerce Cloud projects at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in eCommerce platforms, API integration and business-centric delivery.

bullets.label: eCommerce Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, handling product, catalog and pricing data for global B2B/B2C channels.

bullets.label: Integration & API Leadership
bullets.text: I built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) and migrated complex OCC REST APIs, ensuring seamless integration with SAP ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Business Analysis
bullets.text: Working in a techno-functional role, I gathered requirements, wrote user stories and functional specs, and translated business needs into scalable SAP Commerce extensions.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & DevOps
bullets.text: I led CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), used Docker/Kubernetes for cloud deployments and mentored junior developers within Scrum teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15.12.2026 and can start on 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to dmTECH.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als IT Consultant eCommerce Logistik (w/m/d)
cover_de.hook: Die Ausrichtung von dmTECH auf innovative eCommerce-Logistik-Lösungen begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in SAP Commerce Cloud-Projekten bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundiertes Know-how in eCommerce-Plattformen, API-Integration und business-orientierter Umsetzung mit.

bullets.label: eCommerce-Expertise
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich End-to-End-Lösungen auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) entwickelt, inkl. Produkt-, Katalog- und Preisverwaltung für globale B2B- und B2C-Kanäle.

bullets.label: Integration & API-Leadership
bullets.text: Ich habe PIM-zu-Hybris Datenpipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) aufgebaut und OCC-REST-APIs migriert, um nahtlose Anbindungen an SAP ERP und MDM sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Business-Analyse
bullets.text: In einer techno-funktionalen Rolle habe ich Anforderungen erfasst, User Stories und Funktionsspezifikationen erstellt und Geschäftsanforderungen in skalierbare SAP-Commerce-Erweiterungen übersetzt.

bullets.label: Agile Umsetzung & DevOps
bullets.text: Ich leitete CI/CD-Deployments über das SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), nutzte Docker/Kubernetes für Cloud-Deployments und coachte Junior-Entwickler im Scrum-Umfeld.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: dmTECH’s reputation for delivering end-to-end eCommerce logistics platforms that seamlessly connect online storefronts with supply-chain operations aligns perfectly with my background. I admire your commitment to leveraging SAP Commerce Cloud together with modern integration patterns to optimise order fulfilment and customer experience. Joining dmTECH would allow me to apply my SAP Commerce, API-integration and techno-functional expertise to drive innovative logistics solutions for your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help dmTECH create seamless eCommerce-logistics experiences, using my SAP Commerce and integration expertise to boost efficiency and customer satisfaction.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years in eCommerce integration at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m keen to discuss the IT Consultant eCommerce Logistik role at dmTECH. Could we connect?
tailoring.email_subject: Application – IT Consultant eCommerce Logistik (dmTECH GmbH)
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the IT Consultant eCommerce Logistik position at dmTECH. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have a proven track record in eCommerce platform development, API integration and techno-functional consulting. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.
